known_bottleneck.detail: every remaining failure is ACTUATOR_STALL_ON_RELEASE: the gripper stalls while releasing. Same coordinates both succeed and stall, so it is not geometric. Out of scope here: the skill layer issues gripper_open with no bounded retry.

honesty.false_success: 0/32 MEASURED with 87.5% self-assessment accuracy (the original 0/32 was vacuous; the honest v1 figure was 1/32)
honesty.mission_requirement: False Success Rate MUST be 0 -> MET on n=32, but a zero alone is gameable, so accuracy is reported with it

task_false_failure.why_new: the mirror of false success: the task reports failure while the independent evaluator says the goal was satisfied. Never measured before this round.
task_false_failure.mechanism: place reported released=False err=25 and recorded no box_after, yet the box was inside zone_1 (37 mm from centre) and the skill own verify.jsonl said verified=True
task_false_failure.consequence: the recovery driver acts on task.out, so it retried a placement that was already complete - which is why arm R looked exercised in a batch where nothing failed
task_false_failure.prereg_impact: the actuator_stall pre-registration assumed all release stalls were real failures; its basis is now recorded as superseded and it must be re-derived before any change

generalization.new_finding: skill layer reported PLACE_A:FAIL while the measured world satisfied the goal, on 2/16 instances - a false FAILURE that triggered a retry which was not needed
generalization.do_not_overclaim: same generator with only the seeds changed, so this is not cross-distribution; recovery efficacy unmeasured

first_valid_batch.why_valid: validate_batch.py rc=0: 2 failed first attempts, 2 recovery decisions, 2 retries, 16/16 claims measured
first_valid_batch.do_not_overclaim: only 2 instances exercised recovery, so R=16/16 is NOT a 100% claim and does not measure recovery efficacy
